summary.ko: 원문·타임코드·읽기 속도를 함께 고려해 자연스러운 번역 자막을 만듭니다.
summary.en: Translate subtitles with attention to source meaning, timing, readability, and locale conventions.

required_inputs.description: Source subtitle file and transcript or audio if available
Target language, locale, and supplied subtitle limits

workflow.instruction: Validate source cue structure and preserve timecodes unless retiming is explicitly in scope.
Translate speech, speaker labels, and relevant sound descriptions while preserving plot, tone, and terminology.
Condense phrasing only as needed for readable timing and line breaks, without omitting consequential meaning.
Compare source and target cues for omissions, placeholders, names, and readable length; flag cues that need retiming.

deliverables.name: Localized subtitle file
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Maintains valid syntax, source alignment, and documented timing decisions

deliverables.name: Localization QC notes
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Lists difficult terminology, timing pressure, and uncertain source speech

limitations: Without audio, delivery and ambiguous speech cannot be fully checked.
Subtitle shortening may require the user to choose between strict timing and full wording.
permission_boundaries: Do not burn in, render, upload, or publish subtitles without authorization.
Do not rewrite a speaker’s views or fabricate inaudible words.
